notes.title: DevLog 3# New Mechanics & Prologue Release Date!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png

Hello Chefs! 👨‍🍳

As independent developers, we’ve been working hard to bring you the best experience possible.

In our last update, we made the tough decision to postpone the release of the Prologue version. We wanted to make sure everything was just right – and now, the wait is finally over!

New Features Are Here! 🎉

We’ve been working non-stop to add brand new mechanics and polish existing ones. Your feedback has been a huge part of this journey – thank you for helping shape the game! Let’s dive into what’s new:

Placement! 🧱

You can now place and move objects wherever you want in your restaurant! Organize your kitchen layout to match your style and efficiency. Freedom is yours!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/3d1fb0a1f18b06c3812f4f9f68fea855bb57ff66.gif

Pizza Station! 🍕

Yes, pizza is now officially on the menu! Prepare dough, add toppings, bake it right, and keep those slices coming. Get creative with your orders and keep customers happy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/66f7de646b8d1c84a0c49272ce035745eb314748.gif

Kebab (Doner) Station 🌯

Spice things up with the all new doner station! Slice from the rotating grill, serve it in bread or wraps, and become a kebab master.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/fa745d78256fc919f3e72d96783046309e96c827.gif

Grill Zones! 🔥

Not every spot on the grill is the same anymore. Some areas are hotter and cook faster, while others are cooler. Pay attention to where you place your food – timing matters more than ever!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/625099725a16da26d3c93fec15b3484df1cd07cd.gif

Repair Mechanic! 🛠️

Machines wear out with use. If you ignore them too long, they can break or worse, catch fire! Keep your equipment in top shape with regular maintenance and avoid disasters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/b7788a96961b4d00236c3dad779e30072bc3e74e.gif

Level System 📈

We’ve added a level system! Gain XP by running your restaurant, and unlock better machines, tools, and features as you level up. Progression has never been this fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/1c58bdc05ed0da043900615e2184a712baa9f02d.gif

Fry Station! 🍟

French fries are now here to make your customers even happier! Use the new multiple fryer system to serve them fast and crispy. No one likes soggy fries, right?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/9641f7c50122fe231fbfef4cbaaec09c488dd4f8.gif

notes.content:

We now plan to launch the Prologue after Steam Next Fest, and we’ll be announcing the new release date very soon.

Thank you for your patience and understanding! Your support keeps us going, and we can’t wait to share more with you soon.

notes.title: DevLog 2# Upcoming Features! 🔥
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png

Hello, Chefs! 👨‍🍳

Thank you to everyone who played the Drive Thru Simulator demo!

We’ve wrapped up the demo period and temporarily removed it from the store. But don’t worry – the Prologue version of Drive Thru Simulator is coming very soon!

During this time, we’ve carefully reviewed all the feedback we received during Steam Next Fest and Steam Cooking Fest and continued improving the demo version.

In this development log, we’d like to share the progress we’ve made and the exciting new features we plan to introduce.

New Features! ✨

We’re continuously enhancing the game based on your feedback and needs. Over time, we aim to include all the key features you'd expect in a fast-food restaurant.

Burger Patty Cooking! 🍔

Burger patties now have more realistic stages: raw, cooked, and burnt! Be careful, or your customers might be disappointed. Cooking percentages are now clearer – they increase by 1% per second, giving you full control!

notes.title: New Update - Drive Thru Simulator (v.0.9)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png

Hello, Drive Thru Players! 🍟🍔 

Following the Steam Next Fest and the Land Of Crescent Turkey event, we’ve once again felt the energy and passion of the gaming community. Now it’s time to introduce you to our culinary adventure, the Cooking Fest event, where the art of cooking takes center stage!

Thanks to your interest in these events and the valuable feedback you’ve shared, we’re making step-by-step improvements to the game. With our latest update, we’re working to make your gameplay experience richer and smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/4b95434f8679c68e9c957d642795c6fbe8bff345.png

New Features 📌

Trash System

✅ A new system has been added that rewards players with money when trash is taken outside.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/eb22737e4ee0f1c55c0cf04155b12562fc34217e.gif

Order Control System

✅ A system for detailed control and management of order contents has been added.

Customer Satisfaction

✅ The impact of customer satisfaction on gameplay and player success has been made more evident.

Office Decoration

✅ A system for buying and placing objects in the office area of the market has been added.

✅ Objects can be rotated with the Q and E keys and placed with the R key.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/d12feac5de6f430f43eaa4785485cabbd23a6b8f.gif

Grill Management and Interactions

✅ The grill can be moved and positioned.

✅ The cooking status of patties is displayed on the user interface.

✅ Sound and visual effects have been added to the grilling process.

Burger Stand UI and Ingredient Visuals

✅ Objects placed on the burger stand are now displayed in the user interface.

✅ Ingredients are supported with visual effects.

Area Pollution

✅ The pollution level of used areas is now traceable.

✅ The quality of food prepared in dirty areas and its impact on customer satisfaction has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/788f296caf5c025d317f2128346e730a8c222009.gif

Customer Reactions

✅ Customers can notice dirt and react accordingly:

Phase 1: In slightly dirty areas, the chance of customers noticing is low.
Phase 2: In moderately dirty areas, the chance is higher. 
Phase 3: In very dirty areas, cleaning becomes mandatory as customers will definitely notice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/a4601ebe19e32081ae3b9ec9a75f120eae99acdc.gif

Cleaning Supplies

✅ Various cleaning products have been added to the market and are now usable.

✅ The durability of cleaning products is now tracked in the game.

Object Data

✅ Detailed data for each object is now accessible to the user.

Cargo System

Changes and improvements have been made to the cargo system.

✅ A handcart has been added to the market and can be used for cargo transportation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/d709bb4ad9b6b643b96341a65b2b2d04e1e00eea.gif

Bug Fixes

Tutorial System

✅ Improvements and bug fixes have been made to the tutorial system to make it easier for players to adapt.

Let’s head to the kitchens! See you at the Cooking Fest!

notes.title: DevLog 1# Upcoming Features and Gameplay 🔥
notes.content:
Welcome! Here's Drive Thru Simulator DevLog #1: Animations, Interactions, Gameplay, and Much More for You... 🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/48d12e98af371991d843f0bf2e8d90270dbb8273.png

Hello, Entrepreneurs! 👨‍🍳

First of all, we want to thank you for your immense interest and valuable feedback throughout the development process! Your support has been an incredible source of motivation for us.

Without compromising the main theme of the game, we have been working tirelessly to provide you with an enjoyable gaming experience. We are excited to talk about the new features we have added to the game during the development phase.

Also, we have great news! You’ll be able to access the demo version of Drive Thru Simulator during the ‘‘Steam Next Fest 2024’’ event in October.

Step Into the World of Fast Food! 🍔

Are you ready to keep up with the fast pace of the fast food world? We have prepared an intense, fun, and challenging experience that will make you feel like you're in a real fast food restaurant.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/4b95434f8679c68e9c957d642795c6fbe8bff345.png

New Features ✨

We are continuing to develop our game based on your feedback and needs. We will keep adding all the essential features that a fast food restaurant should have over time.

Deliverable Foods and Machines! 🍕🍟🍔

Burger Making 🍔 You will be able to prepare delicious hamburgers by looking at the burger preparation area. Your goal in this event is to place the correct ingredients for the specified types of burgers and prepare your perfect hamburger!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/210c746be92d717d3ec61d0a6d52521fa129806c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/fe06f5549db939273b1173c0c3e233806d9ec5ef.gif

Pizza Making 🍕 We’re excited to bring you a new update for pizza lovers! In our game, you can show off your skills by preparing pizzas. After the pizzas are placed in the pizza oven, they must be baked to perfection and then packaged and ready for service.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/bcaa8314332af5a1961deb325a7a8e3e6ef1681a.gif

Fry Making 🍟 Time to get your kitchen ready for crispy fries! Are you ready to prepare the best fries and boost your customer satisfaction?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/be5f1fd94cbfbe3e881cadad801c06b93f89b9bc.gif

❗Remember: Undercooked or burnt items will negatively affect your customer satisfaction. By preparing perfectly cooked products, you can take your customer satisfaction to the top.

Deliverable Drinks and Machines! ☕ 🥤

Coffee Machine ☕ Great news for coffee lovers! Now, you can make coffee in our game to keep your customers happy. To prepare coffee, you first need to order S, M, and L cups from the computer system.

Soda Machine 🥤 How about preparing refreshing sodas? With the soda machine, we’re adding even more flavor to the game! You will need to order soda options from the computer system.

User Interface and Experience! 🖥️

Storage Areas 📦

We continue to develop the game to enrich your experience. With the storage areas we’ve added to the game, you will be able to increase your service speed and maximize customer satisfaction.

Deep Freezer Area 🧊: A special deep freezer area is available to everyone at the start of the game. This area is reserved for burger ingredients by default, and you’ll be able to expand it with money to store various frozen products.

Market System 🛒

Online Market 💻 Our online market, designed to meet your in-game needs, serves as a virtual shopping center where you can find everything, including tools and ingredients. Thanks to the catalog feature, you can quickly find the products you need and easily place your orders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/844e145b074e2d4b8f7ea9dc9a86e49a738bb473.gif

Cargo Packages 📦 Your orders are carefully packaged and delivered to your doorstep in cargo packages. You can open the packages, place the items in your storage areas, or use them directly in your production areas.

Economy System 💸

Dear Drive Thru Simulator players, we have worked on a system that will make cash transactions more realistic and interactive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/89f1d1a61a810153e978c6a1af166b58299b4786.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45145770/95f3f960547193115c64f18e3ce3113c23dfe360.gif

Detailed Money Tracking 🔍 When you receive payments from customers, you will be able to see the amount received, the total order price, the amount of change to be returned, and the amount currently being returned on your cash register screen. After each transaction, this information will be updated, allowing you to fully track the flow of money.

Physical Money Interaction 💵 Money is physically present in the cash register and is interactive! While giving and receiving money, you can handle the transactions realistically, ensuring you give the correct amounts to keep customers happy.

Incorrect Payment Results 📉 Be careful; if you give too much money, the extra amount cannot be recovered, which will result in a loss for you. If you make an underpayment, customer satisfaction will be negatively affected, leading to potential customer loss.
